## About
Tru-Line Frame & Wheel does automotive under-car repair for cars and light trucks of all makes and models, with a focus on suspension, steering, brake and structural systems. The work is backed by the latest technical data and diagnostic equipment available.
This is a Tate family shop. Byron Tate, son of company founder Raymond Tate, is President and Owner. His son Doug is Vice President of Tru-Line Seattle, and Doug's son Devon works in the shop as a technician. There is also a second location, Tru-Line Bellevue, for Eastside customers.
Our technicians evaluate and identify your specific issues and address them appropriately, without up-selling unnecessary parts or services. Customers rate the shop 4.8 from 272 Google reviews.

## Services
- Computerized suspension, steering, and alignment services: It starts with a full evaluation of the structural suspension and steering systems. The alignment is then tailored to how you use the car, from daily commuting or performance street to track or combined use.
- Suspension system modifications: Installation of lowering kits, coil over systems, lift kits, sway bar systems and more.
- Brake system service and repair: Routine maintenance, system repairs and performance upgrades, on everything from vintage classics to today's complex braking systems.
- Complete wheel and tire mounting and balancing: Mounting and balancing on computerized equipment we keep up to date. Through our partnership with Tire Rack we can also offer a large range of wheels and tires.
- Structural repair: Under-car frame and uni-structural repair, from mild impact damage and suspension and steering mounting points to full frame replacement.
- Classic, exotic and restoration structural work: Older and classic cars often need structural improvements or reinforcements. We have the experience to restore them properly.
- Specialized diagnostic services: Odd noises while driving, or complex and intermittent handling symptoms. Our technicians track down the cause and get the car driving the way it should.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Call or email the shop. Have the VIN or the vehicle year, make and model ready, plus a brief description of the symptoms and the service you want. Appointments are typically scheduled a week or more in advance.

Q: What are your hours?
A: The Seattle shop is open Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Is the work under warranty?
A: Yes. All service is backed by a comprehensive warranty. Ask us and we'll provide the details.

Q: Do you work on classic cars?
A: Yes. Our brake work covers vintage classics as well as modern systems, and we do structural work on classics and restoration projects. One reviewer brought in a Plymouth Fury for brake, suspension and alignment work.

Q: Do you have a shop on the Eastside?
A: Yes. Tru-Line Bellevue serves Eastside customers. Call 425.462.0013 to reach that location.
